notes.title: Steam Deck Verified!
notes.notes:
Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition is now Verified for the Steam Deck!

With the Dance of the Throne update, we've addressed a few visual and UI scaling issues when played on the Steam Deck, resulting in a more consistent experience when reading certain on-screen elements and texts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39916525/c764550534cd6ed3f3254e0890b8daece92741bc.jpg[/img]

Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition already runs great on the Deck with a 60fps experience and support for the native 1280x800 resolution of the screen. We recommend using Proton 7.0-5 for the best compatibility, but we also expect all recent and experimental Proton versions to work well. In addition, the game is also touch enabled!

That's all for today, we'll see you on the go!

notes.title: Dance of the Throne Comes to Pascal's Wager Definitive Edition December 9th
notes.notes:
The Soul of Obsession carrying the will of all Demiurges has been summoned to Solas again, and it's here for revenge!

In Dance of the Throne, Pascal’s Wager’s latest add-on content, Elena, the leader of Demiurge, will be arriving as a playable character. You'll use Elena to challenge rearranged stages and enemy configurations in Pascal's Wager. Defeat all enemies as quickly as possible, rack up chains, obtain your highest score, and fight your way to the top of the leaderboard against players from all over the world! The exquisite map design of Pascal's Wager will be preserved in these rearranged stages, but secrets are waiting to be explored and discovered in every corner of the map!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39916525/d77117be1507a593bb03ce6776ba887eab81d8ac.jpg[/img]

Elena's weapon Blade of Revenge can be switched between single and dual blade forms, giving her two distinct styles in combat. Elena can perform fierce counters and dodge like a phantom, so enemies are nothing before her. Unlike the high-intensity combat and character progression system of Pascal's Wager, Dance of the Throne brings a more accessible experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39916525/27923e7d73e7fa5f2a967a7154843bbc5b3d8390.jpg[/img]

As part of Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition, Dance of the Throne and Elena's exclusive outfit "Enigma" will be coming as part of a free update releasing tomorrow, December 9th. Everyone here at TipsWorks thanks the community for your understanding and continued support, and we hope to see you in Solas again!

notes.title: Game Update 1.2.0: Fov Slider, Exclusive Fullscreen and Visual Effect Toggle
notes.notes:
We just released the first major update to Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition, which includes a lot of the changes we outlined in our March [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1456650/view/3044969559719505605]Development Update[/url]. After the update the game should show 1.0.2(1000) in the bottom left corner of the main menu.

Full patch notes below:

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Added exclusive fullscreen display mode. The original Fullscreen mode is renamed to Borderless. Windowed mode is unchanged.
[*] Added a field of view (FoV) slider.
[*] Added a toggle for abnormal effects, which controls the intensity of chromatic abberation and vignette effect when characters are under abnormal status.
[*] On screen input prompts now correctly changes based on the control method used.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39916525/66e6c7bc683a44c2b75b065fa8b01dac362946b9.jpg[/img]

[b]Localization[/b]
[list]
[*] Standardized Health Potion capacity upgrade talent in European/LATAM languages.
[*] Fixed an issue where the passive text on Chaos Silk is missing in European/LATAM languages.
[*] Fixed Benita's talent "Elixir Research" to correctly state its blessing related effect in European/LATAM languages.[/list]
[b]Combat[/b]
[list]
[*] Widened parry/counterattack window for Terrence.
[*] Increased movement speed of Terrence and Norwood when locking onto enemies.
[*] Increased the effectiveness of Terrence's "Knight's Tenacity" talent (heavy attacks are harder to interrupt).[/list]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing Viola's followed up attack after a Light Combo to miss enemies occasionally.
[*] Fixed several special effect issues.[/list]

[h2]What's Left Out There?[/h2]

Out of the items we wish to address in our Development Update, there are a few things left we are releasing soon after and at later dates.

[b]Steam Trading Card: [/b]we are finalizing the review process with Valve and will enable this feature once everything goes through.

[b]UI Improvements: [/b]the changes to overall UI elements will take more time than we expected, and we want to make sure the final results meets your expectations and our own standard, so it will be included in an upcoming update.

If you encounter further issues after the update, please don't hesitate to send us feedback on [url=https://twitter.com/PascalsWager_]Twitter[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1456650/discussions/]Steam discussion[/url], and our official [url=https://discord.gg/pascalswagergame]Discord[/url] server. , thank you for your support.

notes.title: Development Update: FOV Slider, Steam Trading Cards, and More
notes.notes:
The original Pascal's Wager was released on a vastly different platform, played on drastically smaller screensize with a different subset of control scheme. We were very clearly underprepared for the challenges and landscape of PC, and we would like to apologize for the suboptimal experience with the launch version of Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition. With the amount of feedback gathered since release, we would like to talk about what we have in store for the game in terms of improvement and additions.

[h2]Camera and Controls[/h2]

Pascal's Wager's control fundamentals are directly geared towards using a controller as the primary means to play, and we clearly underestimated the amount of PC players that primarily use keyboard and mouse to play similar games. This resulted in suboptimal controls for keyboard and mouse players. We have already released several updates to address this, and we are continuing to optimize game control for all players.

[list]
[*] Add an FOV slider.
[*] Separate controller and KB/M button prompts.
[/list]
[h2]User Interface[/h2]

The original Pascal's Wager's interface was designed for much smaller screen sizes than PC monitors and TV. The current interface experience is largely adequate, but the visual quality is not what we intend for the game to look like. For the next phase of development, we plan to do some adjustment to the user interface in order to make it more at home for PC monitor usage.

[h2]Visual Effects[/h2]

We made several graphics enhancements for the Definitive Edition release. However, with much larger screens, the inadequacy of some of the original assets is quite clear (e.g., skybox in the first level). We plan to improve those shortcomings, and add more visual effect controls to game settings. In addition, we are adding new display mode for players to better utilize higher end hardware through DSR down sampling.

[list]
[*] Improve some lower quality assets.
[*] Add options for post process effects.
[*] Add exclusive fullscreen display mode.
[/list]
We are also continuing to address game bugs and improve overall game stability. Outside of the game, we also plan to add Steam trading cards, so players can showcase Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition on their personal profile.

The development team thanks all players for your feedback and support for Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition, and we as always welcome you to get in touch through [url=https://twitter.com/PascalsWager_]Twitter[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1456650/discussions/]Steam discussion[/url], and our official [url=https://discord.gg/pascalswagergame]Discord[/url] server. Thank you for playing!

[list]

[list]

notes.title: Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition is now out on Steam!
notes.notes:
The wait is over, Couriers! Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition is now out on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1456650/Pascals_Wager_Definitive_Edition/

Definitive Edition is an enhanced release of our dark fantasy action RPG, which supports enhanced features like 4K resolution, uncapped framrates, control customization, includes all released content for Pascal's Wager as a full package, and is available for $19.99 or your regional equivalent. Starting today through March 26th, early purchasers also get the original soundtrack for no additional charge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39916525/a0416a393016f875168627d0ee64577c334dabff.jpg[/img]

Pascal's Wager will continue to be available for purchase on Apple App Store, Google Play, TapTap and Huawei AppGallery.

The Definitive Edition release is not the end of the road for Pascal's Wager. We will continue to maintain and improve the game on all platforms, and we still have a little something on our hands that you probably will like a lot, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition lands on Steam March 12th!
notes.notes:
A dark world... Is calling for its new Couriers!

We are excited to announce that Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition is launching on Steam on March 12th!

[previewyoutube=dzms9Z3HYeE;full][/previewyoutube]

Ever since Pascal's Wager's original launch, bringing the game to other platforms has been one of the very top feedback and requests from players, and we are happy to finally release it on Steam! Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition comes with all previously released content, including Into the Dark Mist update, expansion The Tides of Oblivion, plus outfits for Terrence, Benita and Viola.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39916525/a0416a393016f875168627d0ee64577c334dabff.jpg[/img]

Definitive Edition also comes with a slew of PC specific feature support like 4K resolution, ultrawide aspect ratio, uncapped framerate, fully mappable controls and enhanced visuals, delivering the definitive Pascal's Wager experience.

Wishlist Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition now to get notifications when it becomes available on March 12th for $19.99 or your regional equivalent! We are also running a 10% launch discount through March 26th, plus all early purchases during this time get the Original Soundtrack for no additional charge!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1456650/Pascals_Wager_Definitive_Edition/

TipsWorks thanks all players for your support for Pascal's Wager, and we hope you have a blast exploring Solas in Pascal's Wager: Definitive Edition!
